purpose: Context KB for pacs.004 PaymentReturn validation and transformation. For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and all possible fixes. Based on CBPR+ SR2025 Usage Guideline (pacs.004.001.10) and SWIFT MX Enterprise KB.
reference_documents: SWIFT MX Enterprise LLM KB v2.0

iso_20022_rules.RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl: If CopyDuplicate is present, Related MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.InstructedAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstdAgt is present, then TxInf/InstdAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.InstructingAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstgAgt is present, then TxInf/InstgAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmountRu: If GrpHdr/TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, all TxInf/RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt must use the same currency.
iso_20022_rules.TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmountAn: If GrpHdr/TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, it must equal the sum of all TxInf/RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.
iso_20022_rules.GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is present, TxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is not present, TxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.ChargesInformationRule: If TxInf/ChrgBr indicates charges, the charge details in TxInf/ChrgsInf must be consistent with the returned and original settlement amounts.
iso_20022_rules.NumberOfTransactionsAndReturnsRule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of TxInf occurrences.
iso_20022_rules.OriginalGroupInformationRule: TxInf/OrgnlGrpInf must reference the original message via OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId.
iso_20022_rules.PaymentReturnReasonRule: TxInf/RtrRsnInf must be present and carry a return reason (Rsn/Cd or Rsn/Prtry).
iso_20022_rules.ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmountRule: TxInf/RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt must be present and must not exceed TxInf/OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt when both are present.
iso_20022_rules.OriginalReferencesRule: At least one of OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId or OrgnlUETR must be present to identify the original transaction.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr/Priority must equal TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both are present.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match InstgAgt BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match InstdAgt BIC, except when CpyDplct = COPY or CODU.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match InstgAgt BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match InstdAgt BIC when CpyDplct is absent.
If BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed in the same FinInstnId block.
If Nm is present in FinInstnId, PstlAdr must also be present, and vice versa.
All proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr/RmtInf/AddtlInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf/AddtlInf extended with !#$&%*=^_{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (min occurrence changed to 1).
DateTime fields must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format. Z suffix is forbidden. Milliseconds are forbidden.
CBPR+ allows single transactions only per message.
BranchIdentification is removed from InstgAgt, InstdAgt, DbtrAgt, CdtrAgt, IntrmyAgt1/2/3 and PrvsInstgAgt1/2/3.
RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd must be a valid ExternalReturnReason code; AddtlInf limited to 105 characters per occurrence.
OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgNmId must reference a valid original message identifier (e.g. pacs.008.001.08, pacs.003.001.08, pacs.009.001.08).

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, and optionally Prty.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain BIC8 or BIC11 when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{InstgAgt_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI value from TxInf/InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr BICFI does not match TxInf/InstgAgt BICFI (when CpyDplct is absent or not COPY/CODU).
possible_fixes: Read InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to the same value.
Alternatively update InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI to match AppHdr/Fr if Fr is the authoritative source.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain BIC8 or BIC11 on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{InstdAgt_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from TxInf/InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/To BICFI does not match TxInf/InstdAgt BICFI.
possible_fixes: Read InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to match.
Alternatively update InstdAgt/BICFI to match AppHdr/To if To is authoritative.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value.

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/GrpHdr/MsgId.
possible_fixes: Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is the source of truth, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match BizMsgIdr.
Never invent a new value — always harvest from the other field.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Ensure the truncated value remains meaningful and unique.
Synchronize the truncated value back to GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pacs.004.001.10</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.004.001.10).
Extract the message identifier portion and set MsgDefIdr to 'pacs.004.001.10'.
Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025 (minimum occurrence changed to 1); must be 'swift.cbprplus.03'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value (e.g. 'swift.cbprplus.02' from older release).
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.03' as mandated by SR2025.
Note: SR2024 and earlier used 'swift.cbprplus.02'; upgrade to .03 for SR2025.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; Z and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Replace trailing 'Z' with '+00:00'.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt contains milliseconds which are forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Remove millisecond component.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is in the past beyond tolerance window.
possible_fixes: Replace with the current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format.

tags.description: Priority of the Business Message. If present, must match TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty contains a value not in the allowed code list.
possible_fixes: Replace with 'NORM' (normal) or 'HIGH' (high priority).
Default to 'NORM' if priority is not specifically determined.

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty does not match TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.
possible_fixes: Set AppHdr/Prty to the same value as TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.
Alternatively set the original PmtTpInf/InstrPrty to match AppHdr/Prty.

tags.description: Unique message identifier of the payment return. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. No spaces.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Ensure the same value is in AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters preserving meaningful prefix.
Synchronize truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId already exists in the receiving system (duplicate message).
possible_fixes: Generate a new unique MsgId by appending current date and incrementing counter.
Check sending system for duplicate submission logic.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set or contains spaces.
possible_fixes: Remove spaces from MsgId.
Replace special/accented characters with ASCII equivalents.
Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + (no leading or trailing spaces).

tags.description: Creation date and time of the return. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with '+00:00'.

errors.description: CreDtTm contains milliseconds; forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Strip milliseconds.

errors.description: CreDtTm is too far in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with current datetime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00.

tags.description: Number of return transactions. Must equal actual count of TxInf blocks. CBPR+ allows single transactions only (value = 1).

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs is absent.
possible_fixes: Count the actual number of TxInf blocks and insert <NbOfTxs>{count}</NbOfTxs>.
For CBPR+ single-transaction messages, value should be '1'.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual number of TxInf blocks. Error code X00062.
possible_fixes: Count all TxInf elements in the message and set NbOfTxs to that count.
For CBPR+, ensure only one TxInf block exists and NbOfTxs = 1.

errors.description: CBPR+ requires single transactions only; multiple TxInf blocks found.
possible_fixes: Split the message into separate pacs.004 messages, one per returned transaction.
Remove extra TxInf blocks if they are duplicates.

errors.description: NbOfTxs contains non-numeric characters.
possible_fixes: Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits).

tags.description: Control sum. If present, must equal the sum of all TxInf/RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt values.

errors.description: CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
If only one transaction (CBPR+), CtrlSum should equal the single RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.
Remove CtrlSum if not required to avoid mismatch errors.

errors.description: CtrlSum contains non-numeric or invalid decimal value.
possible_fixes: Use a valid decimal number format.
Maximum 18 digits total with up to 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Settlement method for the returned funds. INGA = settled on books of instructed agent (CBPR+ preferred).

errors.description: SttlmMtd is absent from SttlmInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <SttlmMtd>INGA</SttlmMtd> as first child of SttlmInf.

errors.description: SttlmMtd contains a value not in the allowed codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: INDA, INGA, COVE, CLRG.
Use INGA for standard CBPR+ interbank settlement.

tags.description: GrpHdr-level instructing agent of the return. If present, TxInf/InstgAgt must be absent (R5).

errors.description: Both GrpHdr/InstgAgt and TxInf/InstgAgt are present; this violates R5.
possible_fixes: Remove GrpHdr/InstgAgt if agent is already specified at transaction level.
Remove TxInf/InstgAgt if agent is specified at group level.

tags.description: GrpHdr-level instructed agent of the return. If present, TxInf/InstdAgt must be absent (R4).

errors.description: Both GrpHdr/InstdAgt and TxInf/InstdAgt are present; this violates R4.
possible_fixes: Remove GrpHdr/InstdAgt if agent is specified at transaction level.
Remove TxInf/InstdAgt if agent is specified at group level.

tags.description: Transaction Information. Root return transaction block (PaymentTransaction118). Contains return identification, original references, original and returned settlement amounts, agents, return chain, return reason information and the original transaction reference. CBPR+ restricts to a single occurrence (NbOfTxs = 1).

errors.description: TxInf block is absent from PmtRtr.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <TxInf> block containing RtrId, OrgnlGrpInf, RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt, RtrRsnInf and OrgnlTxRef.

errors.description: Multiple TxInf blocks present; CBPR+ permits a single transaction only.
possible_fixes: Retain a single TxInf block and set GrpHdr/NbOfTxs to 1.
Split additional returns into separate pacs.004 messages.

tags.description: Return identification assigned by the instructing agent of the return. Unique reference for the payment return transaction.

errors.description: RtrId is absent from TxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <RtrId>{unique return reference, max 35 chars}</RtrId> as first child of TxInf.

errors.description: RtrId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum preserving the unique prefix.

tags.description: Original Group Information. References the original message being returned via OrgnlMsgId, OrgnlMsgNmId and optionally OrgnlCreDtTm.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf is absent; the return must reference the original message group (R12).
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlGrpInf><OrgnlMsgId>{original MsgId}</OrgnlMsgId><OrgnlMsgNmId>{original message identifier}</OrgnlMsgNmId></OrgnlGrpInf>.
Harvest OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId from the original payment message being returned.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgId>{original MsgId, max 35 chars}</OrgnlMsgId> harvested from the original message.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgNmId is absent or does not reference a valid original message identifier.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlMsgNmId>{e.g. pacs.008.001.08}</OrgnlMsgNmId>.
Valid values include pacs.008.001.08, pacs.003.001.08, pacs.009.001.08.

errors.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlCreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix or milliseconds; forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with '+00:00' and remove milliseconds.

tags.description: Original end-to-end identification of the returned transaction. Harvested unchanged from the original payment PmtId/EndToEndId.

errors.description: OrgnlEndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum.
Preserve the original end-to-end reference exactly as received where possible.

errors.description: None of OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId or OrgnlUETR are present; at least one is required to identify the original transaction (R15).
possible_fixes: Populate at least one of OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId or OrgnlUETR from the original payment.
OrgnlUETR is the preferred original reference when available.

tags.description: Original transaction identification of the returned transaction. Harvested unchanged from the original payment PmtId/TxId.

errors.description: OrgnlTxId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum preserving the original unique prefix.

tags.description: Original Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference of the returned transaction. Must equal the UETR of the original payment. Mandatory under CBPR+.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR is absent; mandatory under CBPR+ to preserve the end-to-end reference of the returned payment.
possible_fixes: Insert <OrgnlUETR>{UETR of the original payment}</OrgnlUETR>.
Harvest the UETR from the original message PmtId/UETR; do not generate a new value.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR is not a valid UUID v4 (wrong format, uppercase, wrong version digit, invalid variant).
possible_fixes: Ensure UETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
The 13th character (version) must be '4'.
The 17th character (variant) must be 8, 9, a, or b.
Total length must be exactly 36 characters including hyphens.

errors.description: OrgnlUETR contains uppercase hexadecimal characters; must be lowercase.
possible_fixes: Convert all hex characters in OrgnlUETR to lowercase.

tags.description: Original interbank settlement amount of the payment being returned, with currency attribute (Ccy). Harvested from the original payment IntrBkSttlmAmt. ISO 4217 currency code.

errors.description: OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.

errors.description: OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy attribute is not a valid ISO 4217 currency code.
possible_fixes: Replace Ccy attribute with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

tags.description: Returned interbank settlement amount actually returned between the financial institutions, with currency attribute (Ccy). Amount > 0. Must not exceed OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt when both present (R14).

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt element is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="{ISO4217_currency}">{amount}</RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt>.
Ensure Ccy attribute is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy attribute is not a valid ISO 4217 currency code.
possible_fixes: Replace Ccy attribute with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
Currency codes are always 3 uppercase letters.

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt amount is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal amount greater than zero.
Maximum: 18 digits total, 5 fraction digits.

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt exceeds OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt; the returned amount cannot exceed the original settlement amount (R14).
possible_fixes: Set RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt to a value less than or equal to OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt.
Account for any deducted charges/compensation via ChrgsInf and CompstnAmt rather than inflating the returned amount.

errors.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currency differs from GrpHdr/TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
possible_fixes: Ensure all RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currencies match the TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
Remove TtlRtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt from GrpHdr if currency alignment is not possible.

tags.description: Interbank settlement date of the return. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Mandatory at transaction level when GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is absent (R9). Cannot coexist with GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt (R8). Must be today or a future business day.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is absent from TxInf and GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is also absent; violates R9.
possible_fixes: Insert <IntrBkSttlmDt>{today's date as YYYY-MM-DD}</IntrBkSttlmDt> in TxInf.
Alternatively insert IntrBkSttlmDt at GrpHdr level; if so, remove it from TxInf.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Do NOT use 'Z', time components, or offsets — date only.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is present at both GrpHdr and TxInf level; violates R8.
possible_fixes: Remove TxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt if GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is the intended location.
Remove GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt if TxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is the intended location.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is not in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. includes time, Z suffix, or slashes).
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component.

tags.description: Settlement priority of the return.

errors.description: SttlmPrty contains a value not in the allowed code list.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: URGT, HIGH, NORM.

tags.description: Settlement time indication for the return. CdtDtTm and DbtDtTm must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; Z and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: SttlmTmIndctn/CdtDtTm or DbtDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with '+00:00'.
Remove millisecond component.

tags.description: Returned instructed amount with currency attribute (Ccy). Nearest equivalent of the source InstdAmt. Used with XchgRate when the returned amount currency differs from the settlement currency.

errors.description: RtrdInstdAmt present but Ccy attribute missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.

errors.description: RtrdInstdAmt currency differs from RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is absent.
possible_fixes: Add TxInf/XchgRate when RtrdInstdAmt and RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currencies differ.
Or align RtrdInstdAmt currency with RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currency.

tags.description: Exchange rate applied between RtrdInstdAmt and RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currencies. Required when the two currencies differ.

errors.description: XchgRate is non-numeric, zero, or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal exchange rate.
Remove XchgRate if RtrdInstdAmt and RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt share the same currency.

errors.description: XchgRate is present but RtrdInstdAmt and RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt have the same currency.
possible_fixes: Remove XchgRate when both amounts are in the same currency.

tags.description: Compensation amount (e.g. interest/value-date compensation) associated with the return, with currency attribute (Ccy).

errors.description: CompstnAmt present but Ccy attribute missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.

tags.description: Charge bearer for the return charges. SLEV = follow service level.

errors.description: ChrgBr contains an invalid code.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: SLEV, SHAR, CRED, DEBT.
Default value is SLEV.

tags.description: Charges information applied to the return. When present, Amt currency must be consistent with the returned/original settlement amounts (R10), and Agt must be present.

errors.description: ChrgsInf is present but the Agt element is absent.
possible_fixes: Add <Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{agent_BIC}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt> inside ChrgsInf.

errors.description: ChrgsInf/Amt currency is inconsistent with the returned/original settlement amount currency context (R10).
possible_fixes: Update ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy to be consistent with the settlement amount currency.
Ensure ChrgBr and ChrgsInf are mutually consistent.

tags.description: Instructing agent of the return. Must have valid BICFI. Must match AppHdr/Fr. Mandatory at transaction level when absent at GrpHdr level.

errors.description: InstgAgt is absent from TxInf (and not present in GrpHdr).
possible_fixes: Insert <InstgAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{instructing_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></InstgAgt> in TxInf.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/Fr.

errors.description: InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: CBPR+: BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr are also present in the same FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

errors.description: BrnchId is present in InstgAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from InstgAgt entirely.

tags.description: Instructed agent of the return. Must have valid BICFI. Must match AppHdr/To. Mandatory at transaction level when absent at GrpHdr level.

errors.description: InstdAgt is absent from TxInf (and not present in GrpHdr).
possible_fixes: Insert <InstdAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{instructed_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></InstdAgt> in TxInf.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/To.

errors.description: InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: CBPR+: BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr are also in the same FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from InstdAgt/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

errors.description: BrnchId is present in InstdAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from InstdAgt entirely.

tags.description: Return Chain. TransactionParties block conveying the parties of the original payment in the return: Dbtr, DbtrAcct, DbtrAgt, CdtrAgt, Cdtr, CdtrAcct and intermediary agents.

errors.description: RtrChain is present but contains no party elements.
possible_fixes: Populate RtrChain with the original Dbtr, Cdtr and their agents.
Remove RtrChain if no party information is being conveyed.

tags.description: Debtor of the original payment carried in the return chain. Name required for AML/sanctions screening. At least Nm or Id required when present.

errors.description: RtrChain/Dbtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 140 characters maximum.

errors.description: RtrChain/Dbtr contains characters outside the extended charset.
possible_fixes: Replace < with < and > with >.
Remove unsupported characters; Nm/PstlAdr support extended charset.

errors.description: RtrChain/Dbtr/PstlAdr present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside PstlAdr.

tags.description: Debtor account of the original payment. IBAN or Othr; not both simultaneously.

errors.description: RtrChain/DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN (max 34 chars, valid MOD97 check digits).

errors.description: Both IBAN and Othr are present in DbtrAcct/Id; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Othr if IBAN is the correct identifier.
Remove IBAN if Othr is the correct identifier.

tags.description: Debtor agent of the original payment carried in the return chain. BICFI under CBPR+. BrnchId removed.

errors.description: RtrChain/DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

errors.description: RtrChain/DbtrAgt BICFI equals RtrChain/CdtrAgt BICFI — loopback warning.
possible_fixes: Verify the debtor and creditor agents of the original payment are not the same institution.

errors.description: BrnchId present in RtrChain/DbtrAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from DbtrAgt entirely.

tags.description: Creditor agent of the original payment carried in the return chain. BICFI mandatory on SWIFT. Nm/PstlAdr optional when BICFI absent and must be present together. BrnchId removed.

errors.description: RtrChain/CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BICFI.

errors.description: RtrChain/CdtrAgt/FinInstnId has Nm but PstlAdr is absent; Nm and PstlAdr must always be present together.
possible_fixes: Add <PstlAdr><AdrLine>{address}</AdrLine><Ctry>{ISO2_country}</Ctry></PstlAdr> to FinInstnId.
Or use BICFI instead of Nm/PstlAdr.

errors.description: BrnchId present in RtrChain/CdtrAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from CdtrAgt entirely.

tags.description: Creditor of the original payment carried in the return chain. Name required for AML/sanctions screening. At least Nm or Id required when present.

errors.description: RtrChain/Cdtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 140 characters maximum.

errors.description: RtrChain/Cdtr/PstlAdr present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside PstlAdr.

errors.description: Creditor name, country, or identifier matches a sanctioned entity.
possible_fixes: Escalate to compliance team; do not process.
Replace sanctioned country code or name with compliant values where permitted.

tags.description: Creditor account of the original payment. IBAN or Othr; not both simultaneously.

errors.description: RtrChain/CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN (ISO 13616, max 34 chars, MOD97 check digits valid).

errors.description: Both IBAN and Othr are present in CdtrAcct/Id; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Othr if IBAN is the correct identifier.
Remove IBAN if Othr is the correct identifier.

tags.description: First intermediary agent of the original payment carried in the return chain. BrnchId removed. IntrmyAgt2 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt1.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt2 is present but IntrmyAgt1 is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert IntrmyAgt1 before IntrmyAgt2.

possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

errors.description: BrnchId present in IntrmyAgt1; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from IntrmyAgt1 entirely.

tags.description: Payment Return Reason Information. Must be present and carry the return reason (Rsn/Cd or Rsn/Prtry), optional Orgtr and AddtlInf (R13).

errors.description: RtrRsnInf is absent; a payment return must state a return reason (R13).
possible_fixes: Insert <RtrRsnInf><Rsn><Cd>{ExternalReturnReason code}</Cd></Rsn></RtrRsnInf>.
Use a valid ExternalReturnReason code (e.g. AC04, AM05, BE05, RR04).

errors.description: Both RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd and RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Prtry are present; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Prtry if Cd is the correct choice.
Remove Cd if Prtry is the correct choice.

tags.description: Return reason code from the ISO 20022 ExternalReturnReason code list. Mutually exclusive with Rsn/Prtry.

errors.description: RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd is not a valid ExternalReturnReason code.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid ExternalReturnReason code (e.g. AC04 closed account, AM05 duplication, BE05 unrecognised initiating party, RR04 regulatory reason).
Alternatively use RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Prtry for a proprietary reason.

tags.description: Additional return reason information. Limited to 105 characters per occurrence; supports the extended character set.

errors.description: RtrRsnInf/AddtlInf exceeds 105 characters per occurrence.
possible_fixes: Truncate each AddtlInf occurrence to a maximum of 105 characters.

errors.description: AddtlInf contains characters outside the extended charset.
possible_fixes: Replace < with < and > with >.
Remove unsupported characters.

tags.description: Original Transaction Reference. Conveys the key attributes of the original payment being returned: PmtTpInf, RmtInf, Purp, settlement amount/date and original parties for reconciliation.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef is present but contains no reference elements.
possible_fixes: Populate OrgnlTxRef with the original PmtTpInf, RmtInf, Purp and parties.
Remove OrgnlTxRef if no original reference detail is being conveyed.

tags.description: Payment type information of the original payment. InstrPrty must match AppHdr/Prty when both present.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty contains a value not in the allowed codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with NORM or HIGH.
Default: NORM.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty does not match AppHdr/Prty.
possible_fixes: Set InstrPrty to the same value as AppHdr/Prty.
Alternatively, set AppHdr/Prty to match InstrPrty.

tags.description: Remittance information of the original payment. Ustrd and Strd are mutually exclusive within the same RmtInf block.

errors.description: Both Ustrd and Strd are present in the same RmtInf block; they are mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Strd if unstructured remittance is preferred.
Remove Ustrd if structured remittance is preferred.

errors.description: Ustrd text exceeds 140 characters per occurrence.

errors.description: RmtInf contains characters outside the extended charset.

Remove unsupported characters.

tags.description: Purpose of the original payment. Cd (ISO 20022 code) and Prtry are mutually exclusive.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef/Purp/Cd is not in the ISO 20022 external Purpose code list.
possible_fixes: Use a valid ISO 20022 Purpose code (e.g. SUPP, SALA, TRAD, TREA).
Alternatively use Purp/Prtry with a proprietary code (max 35 chars).

errors.description: Both Purp/Cd and Purp/Prtry are present; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Prtry if Cd is the correct choice.
Remove Cd if Prtry is the correct choice.

tags.description: Debtor of the original payment as recorded in the original transaction reference. At least Nm or Id required when present.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef/Dbtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 140 characters maximum.

tags.description: Creditor of the original payment as recorded in the original transaction reference. At least Nm or Id required when present.

errors.description: OrgnlTxRef/Cdtr/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 140 characters maximum.

errors.description: Original creditor name, country, or identifier matches a sanctioned entity.
possible_fixes: Escalate to compliance team; do not process.
Replace sanctioned country code or name with compliant values where permitted.

tags.description: Group return indicator. When 'true' the whole original group is returned and transaction-level original references are not required.

errors.description: GrpHdr/GrpRtr must be a boolean ('true' or 'false').
possible_fixes: Set GrpRtr to 'true' or 'false'.

tags.description: Party that issued the return reason (BICFI or Name). Identifies who initiated the return.

errors.description: RtrRsnInf/Orgtr BICFI is not a valid ISO 9362 BIC.
possible_fixes: Set Orgtr/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC (or FinInstnId/BICFI) to a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

tags.description: Message name identifier of the original message being returned (e.g. 'pacs.008.001.08').

errors.description: OrgnlMsgNmId is absent from OrgnlGrpInf.
possible_fixes: Insert OrgnlMsgNmId with the original message identifier, e.g. <OrgnlMsgNmId>pacs.008.001.08</OrgnlMsgNmId>.

errors.description: OrgnlMsgNmId is not a recognised ISO 20022 message identifier.
possible_fixes: Use the full dotted message identifier of the returned message (pacs.008.001.08, pacs.003.001.08, pacs.009.001.08, ...).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest MsgId from GrpHdr and set BizMsgIdr to same value or vice versa.
Harvest InstgAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/Fr to match.
Harvest InstdAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/To to match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal count of TxInf blocks
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count TxInf elements and update NbOfTxs.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum must equal sum of all RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt values and update CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/Prty must equal OrgnlTxRef/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align both to same value; default NORM.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstgAgt and TxInf/InstgAgt are mutually exclusive (R5)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstdAgt and TxInf/InstdAgt are mutually exclusive (R4)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrBkSttlmDt must be at either GrpHdr or TxInf, not both (R8/R9)
RtrChain/IntrmyAgt2 requires IntrmyAgt1; IntrmyAgt3 requires IntrmyAgt2
If FinInstnId/BICFI present, then Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in same block
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when BICFI is present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If Nm present in FinInstnId, PstlAdr must also be present and vice versa
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing counterpart; or use BICFI.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BrnchId is removed from all agent elements under CBPR+ SR2025
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove all BrnchId elements from agent blocks.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: OrgnlGrpInf must reference the original message (OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId) (R12)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId from the original payment being returned.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: At least one of OrgnlEndToEndId, OrgnlTxId or OrgnlUETR must be present (R15)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate at least one original reference; harvest from the original payment.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: RtrRsnInf must be present and carry a return reason (R13)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate RtrRsnInf/Rsn with a valid ExternalReturnReason code or proprietary reason.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt must not exceed OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt when both present (R14)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set the returned amount less than or equal to the original; convey deductions via ChrgsInf/CompstnAmt.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: XchgRate required when RtrdInstdAmt and RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt currencies differ
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add XchgRate when currencies differ; remove when they match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When GrpHdr/GrpRtr = true the whole group is returned; transaction-level OrgnlInstrId/OrgnlEndToEndId are not required, but OrgnlGrpInf must identify the original message.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: If GrpRtr is true, ensure OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlMsgNmId are present; otherwise populate the per-transaction original references.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: pacs.004.001.10 root is /Document/PmtRtr (PaymentReturn); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for CBPR+ payment return is 'swift.cbprplus.03'.
schema_mapping_notes.structure: GrpHdr [1..1] + TxInf [1..n] (single TxInf under CBPR+). The original payment is referenced by TxInf/OrgnlGrpInf (OrgnlMsgId, OrgnlMsgNmId) and the Orgnl* identifiers; the parties of the returned payment are mirrored in TxInf/RtrChain.
schema_mapping_notes.amount_location: TxInf/RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt is the returned settlement amount; OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt echoes the original; CompstnAmt carries interest compensation. RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt must not exceed OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt.
schema_mapping_notes.return_reason: TxInf/RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd uses ExternalReturnReason1Code (e.g. AC04 closed account, AM09 wrong amount, CUST requested by customer, DUPL duplicate, RR04 missing regulatory info); free text goes in AddtlInf.
schema_mapping_notes.return_chain: TxInf/RtrChain carries the parties of the payment being returned (Dbtr, DbtrAgt, Cdtr, CdtrAgt, intermediaries) so funds can be routed back.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: ISODateTime fields use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; no 'Z' suffix, no milliseconds.
schema_mapping_notes.nb_of_txs_scope: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of TxInf occurrences.
